subtitle: "Index by part, concept and data source"
description: "Catalogue of 79 applications on posterior ranking and ordered grade reporting."
---

The catalogue lists all applications with their subject, data source and location in the collection. Search covers
titles, descriptions and preset names, including the application names used within the interactive displays.
Part, concept and data filters can be combined. Each entry links to an explanatory page and a standalone version
of the application.
